title: Patched Uninstall Engine — endpoint uninstall status
description: Written atomically to /Library/Application Support/Patched/uninstall-status.json by patched-uninstall.sh after each run. World-readable (mode 644). Mirrors the update-status.json pattern.

entry_id.description: tenant_allowlists.id from the platform allowlist store (PAT-375). 0 is the sentinel when an uninstall trigger was refused before tenant allowlist resolution, so no tenant_allowlists row was inspected or selected.

name.description: App name as it appears in the allowlist entry.

outcome.description: removed: gone+verified. removed_residual: app bundle gone but receipts remain. already_removed: not present at run time. manual_removal_required: no method resolved. deferred_app_running: app was running and did not quit; retry next cycle. failed_transient: still present; classified as transient (retry next cycle). failed_hard: still present; OS-protected or MDM-managed. authority_refused: signed execution authority was absent, stale or revoked; terminal and not retryable as an app-running condition. skipped_baseline_protected: safety guard prevented removal of an Apple/MS baseline app.

verify_result.description: Result of post-execution re-inspection. not_checked when removal was not attempted.

method.description: Resolved removal method. macOS: pkg_receipts | vendor_uninstaller | app_bundle. Windows (PAT-379): registry_quiet_uninstall | registry_uninstall | winget | msi. catalogue and none/unresolvable are shared. none when no attempt was made.
